tests.name: actual shared reader classifies each exact fixture rather than an unread empty map
selected component coverage is seven six-page and six eight-page packets
no source field is omitted or classified twice within a fixture component
21 private/unknown field disclosures are verified without inventing execution
all 51 original review input identities remain unchanged
CLI discovers this native candidate without a fabricated approval request
changed native schema fails explicitly with unmeasured counters
deleted native census link cannot fall back to zero inspected fields
changed whole PDF cannot borrow prior review
changed boundary phone facts cannot borrow canonical proof
changed selected-order input cannot borrow no-order proof
missing report write is not a zero missing-field count
forged court field write cannot borrow protected-region proof
omitted census field refuses rather than reducing denominator
changed source receipt refuses the reused source proof
raw source corruption refuses even when receipt is unchanged
modified validator cannot borrow the retained predicate review
missing manual-completion instructions refuse
truncated artifact inventory refuses
adapter supplies source-bound per-fixture inputs to the original classifier
boundary missing phone is correctly permitted only with actual disclosure
held phone cannot be relabelled unknown in the same fixture
removing actual private-field disclosure is caught by existing classifier
removing selected order retains missing-component failure
untyped source blank remains unclassified, not a blanket exception
claimed signature write remains protected
complete original source/output/helper preservation after all mutations
